company.name: Jasmine Energy
company.shortDescription: Jasmine is the easiest way to track prices, verify renewable energy generators, and buy & sell Energy Attribute Certificates (EACs/RECs)
company.description: Jasmine Energy is an AI powered incentive management platform for solar developers. Tracking environmental certificates and credits is complex and time-consuming, leading to missed revenue and administrative headaches. Jasmine automates registration, generation reporting, and credit tracking— starting with RECs and LCFS, Jasmine has helped solar developers, IPPs, TPOs and homeowners generated thousands of dollars in missed revenue, save weeks of manual work, and aggregate small distributed generation to maximize grid value and returns.
company.headquarters: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
